author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists have developed a fluoride-free dental gel inspired by enamel-forming proteins that can rebuild tooth enamel through epitaxial mineralization. This new gel restores both the microstructure and mechanical strength of enamel, potentially transforming dental care by regenerating lost tooth material rather than just strengthening what remains.

Source Article: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-025-64982-y
